  • Modular setups, enabling unique shapes and sizes
  • Waterproof and rugged hardware engineered for outdoor use
  • On-time delivery and full technical support
  • Flexible rental terms—by the day, week, or event

Book a consultation to discuss your specific event needs. Visit our contact page to get started.

Specialty Applications for Sacramento Venues

Our product experts can recommend transparent LED displays for unique window installations or trade show LED solutions for maximum booth impact.

Common Mistakes When Renting LED Displays

  • Underestimating Outdoor Brightness: Choosing indoor models for outdoor use can lead to poor daytime visibility.

  • Ignoring Local Regulations: Sacramento events may require permits; failing to prepare can delay setups.
  • Inadequate Support Arrangements: Poor setup or lack of technical staff can cause avoidable downtime.

Consult with our team to avoid these common pitfalls, ensuring a flawless rental experience.

What size LED displays are available for Sacramento events?

We offer a wide range of sizes to fit any venue, from small custom LED screens to massive outdoor video walls for large events.

Yes, all our outdoor LED displays are IP65+ rated to withstand Sacramento’s sun and weather year-round.

Do you provide setup and breakdown services?

Absolutely. Our team handles delivery, installation, calibration, and post-event removal for every Sacramento rental.

Can displays be branded with my company’s graphics?

Definitely. Our LED platforms support custom content, live video, and interactive branded messages.

Is technical support available during my event?

Yes, we offer on-site and remote support for all Sacramento LED rentals, ensuring smooth operation from start to finish.
